───── answer-price.md ─────
Subject: Re: what it costs
Hi Dave,

It's $20 a month, no contract, and that keeps your site up on your own web address with a few small changes by text each month; that's the Hosting plan. If you'd want changes made regularly, Starter is $99 a month and includes $100 of changes a month. The full range is $20, $50, $99, $250, $400 and $1,000 a month as the amount of work goes up; all six are on the pricing page. No setup fee, and nothing to cancel later: none of the three smallest plans has a minimum, and you cancel by text.

If you'd rather see it work before deciding, text 435-901-7141 and ask it something — that's a real one running a demo business, and you can ask it whatever you like. Fifteen minutes on the phone if that's easier: https://cal.com/taylor/15min

Taylor Remund · Patchlamp
801-555-0100
PO Box 1234, American Fork, UT 84003

───── answer-how.md ─────
Subject: Re: how it works
Hi Dave,

The short version: you text Patch — that's the assistant that looks after your site — in plain words ("put Saturday's hours at 9 to 4", "add the new service"), and it makes the change and texts you back. There's a page you can sign in to and type instead, if you'd rather, and your texts are there to read as well.

The best way to judge it is to use it: text 435-901-7141 and ask it anything. That's a real one running a demo business, so nothing you say to it breaks anything. Your own starts at $20 a month, no contract for the site and a few small changes a month; the plans that do more are on the pricing page. Fifteen minutes on the phone if that's easier: https://cal.com/taylor/15min

Taylor Remund · Patchlamp
801-555-0100
PO Box 1234, American Fork, UT 84003

You wrote to me first, so this is a reply — and, like my first note, an advertisement for my own service. Reply "no thanks" and you won't hear from me again.
Patch, my AI operator, wrote this reply; Taylor reads the ones it flags.


───── answer-yes.md ─────
Subject: Re: a preview for Highland Pool & Spa
Hi Dave,

Here it is: https://preview-highland-pool.pages.dev/

I built it from your Google listing alone, so it only knows what Google knows. The preview stays up for 30 days.

Keeping it as your live site is $20 a month, no contract, on your own web address. If you already have one, I help connect it; if you need one, you buy it and I help connect it. Your Google listing can link to the site.

A few small changes by text each month are included, like changing your hours. After that, you can wait for next month or move up a plan; a full redesign or a big new feature is quoted separately. You text Patch, my AI operator; I'm on the hook for it. Want this to be your live site?

Taylor Remund · Patchlamp
